# 25LS2521 - Eight-bit equal-to comparator

Package DIP-20 · family 25LS · catalogue file [catalog/chips/25LS2521.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/25LS2521.json)

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | /EIN | input |  | enable, active low; also the cascade input |
| 2 | A0 | input |  |  |
| 3 | B0 | input |  |  |
| 4 | A1 | input |  |  |
| 5 | B1 | input |  |  |
| 6 | A2 | input |  |  |
| 7 | B2 | input |  |  |
| 8 | A3 | input |  |  |
| 9 | B3 | input |  |  |
| 10 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 11 | A4 | input |  |  |
| 12 | B4 | input |  |  |
| 13 | A5 | input |  |  |
| 14 | B5 | input |  |  |
| 15 | A6 | input |  |  |
| 16 | B6 | input |  |  |
| 17 | A7 | input |  |  |
| 18 | B7 | input |  |  |
| 19 | /EOUT | output | totem-pole | EQUAL output, active low |
| 20 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 19 | /EOUT = NOT(NOT(A0 XOR B0) AND NOT(A1 XOR B1) AND NOT(A2 XOR B2) AND NOT(A3 XOR B3) AND NOT(A4 XOR B4) AND NOT(A5 XOR B5) AND NOT(A6 XOR B6) AND NOT(A7 XOR B7) AND NOT /EIN) | /EOUT is low when every A bit equals its B bit and /EIN is low; otherwise high. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 8 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.44 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Commercial: VOL 0.45 V max at IOL 8 mA, 0.5 V at 12 mA; VOH 2.7 V min at IOH -440 uA. Input low current: A, B -0.36 mA, /E -0.72 mA. ICC 27 typ / 40 max mA. No internal pull-ups (pages 9-110, 9-111). outputLowMaxCurrentMa is the 8 mA test point; the sheet has no separate recommended IOL. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | /EOUT | PLH | 9 | 15 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 2 kohm (A or B input) |
| A | /EOUT | PHL | 9 | 15 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 2 kohm (A or B input) |
| /EIN | /EOUT | PLH | 5 | 7 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 2 kohm |
| /EIN | /EOUT | PHL | 6 | 8 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 2 kohm |

## Notes

Over the commercial range with CL 50 pF the maximums are A/B to /EOUT 20 ns (PLH), 19 ns (PHL); /E to /EOUT 10.5 ns (PLH), 12.5 ns (PHL) (page 9-112). No minimum delays given. On the card two are cascaded: /EOUT of one into /EIN of the next.

## Sources

- [AMD Am25LS2521 Eight-Bit Equal-to Comparator (03619B), in AMD 1985 Bipolar Microprocessor Logic and Interface Data Book](http://www.bitsavers.org/components/amd/_dataBooks/1985_AMD_Bipolar_Microprocessor_Logic_and_Interface.pdf) - 9-108 to 9-112 (PDF pages 945-949); Am25LS2521 (commercial)
